questiontext.text: Which of the following are major economic reasons why agriculture is vital to Nigeria's national development? (Select all that apply)

generalfeedback.text: Agriculture feeds the population, supplies raw materials, and earns foreign exchange. It does not replace schools or hospitals.

questiontext.text: Which of the following industries are classified as agro-allied industries in Nigeria? (Select all that apply)

generalfeedback.text: Textile mills, tanneries, and vegetable oil refineries are agro-allied because they process cotton, animal hides, and oilseeds.

questiontext.text: Match each branch of agriculture with its primary area of specialization:

generalfeedback.text: Agronomy is field crops/soil; Animal Husbandry is livestock; Aquaculture is fish farming; and Horticulture is fruits/vegetables/flowers.

questiontext.text: Match each agricultural product with the manufacturing industry it feeds:

generalfeedback.text: Cotton feeds textiles; hides feed leather; palm oil feeds soap/margarine; and cocoa feeds chocolate/beverages.
